name: rebuild_ghosts
what: in a SECOND file, makes again the ghost frames that no neighbour can stand in for (fast movement, cuts): each is created by RIFE from the frame before and the frame after. The faithful file is delivered as always and keeps those ghosts
when: ONLY when the person asks to have the remaining double images removed, after deghost has replaced the ones it can. Set the recipe's `rebuild_ghosts`, never as a step; alone it writes a copy at the original rate, with `interpolate` it goes into the frame-rate copy
softens: the frames made again are created picture: a movement's middle is guessed, a one-frame mix of two scenes becomes one of the two scenes
tried_on: owner cartoon at 10 fps: on a shaking-vehicle frame RIFE between the neighbours gave a clean single picture, where motion-vector interpolation (mvtools) left a pile of ghosts; frames whose edge energy dips alone under 0.80 of their neighbours' were ghosts in 10 of 10 looked at
